integration_issues.flow: Provider Dashboard → Perfil → owner_identity persistence via global 'Guardar cambios' button
integration_issues.issue: Clicked form-owner-identity-american then 'Guardar cambios' — backend GET /api/providers/me still returned owner_identity='latino' after save (no change persisted via UI). Either (a) the profile POST/PUT payload from this form doesn't include owner_identity, (b) the milestone-celebration modal (which reappeared during the workflow despite localStorage preload) intercepted the save, or (c) the section requires its own dedicated save button calling PUT /api/providers/me/owner-identity. Direct backend PUT /api/providers/me/owner-identity works perfectly (17/17 backend tests). Needs manual verification by main agent.

Milestone celebration modals ('Primer mensaje recibido', 'Primera solicitud') still surface on /dashboard/provider even after preloading localStorage keys milestone_celebrated_first_msg / first_quote / all. Same carryover from iter-5/iter-6. Non-blocking.

action_items: Verify owner_identity persistence flow from Provider Dashboard Perfil tab — clicking form-owner-identity-american + 'Guardar cambios' should update the provider's owner_identity to 'american' but currently does not (backend still shows 'latino'). Confirm whether ProviderDashboard sends owner_identity in the profile-save payload or wires the click directly to PUT /api/providers/me/owner-identity. Backend endpoints are fully functional.
[OPTIONAL] Unify milestone-suppress keys so testers/QA can disable all celebration modals via a single localStorage flag (e.g. milestone_celebrated_all=1).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~3170 lines — modularization still pending (split into auth, providers, messaging, admin, promo, ads, market-pulse, owner-identity).

Migration block (server.py L502–518) is idempotent and runs at startup — good. However the second update sets owner_identity=None for ALL profiles without it, including potential american providers; consider mapping by another signal if/when american identity data becomes available pre-migration.

OwnerIdentityIn model uses Literal['latino','american'] but the endpoint allows None via payload.owner_identity. Document explicit null-allowed semantics in OpenAPI schema for clarity (Optional[Literal[...]] is fine but ensure Pydantic generates correct schema).
LegalLayout.jsx uses a single SHOW_LEGAL_DRAFT_BANNER constant — good DX for legal sign-off. Consider promoting to env var or admin toggle so it can flip without a redeploy.
OwnerIdentityBadge.jsx hard-codes colors (#E1F5EE / #E6F1FB / #025F67 / #185FA5). Consider extracting to a palette constants file for future theming/i18n.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 7 backend objectives green. UI badges working everywhere (Landing featured card, ProviderECard public page, Community Wall+Leaderboard). 4 legal pages render with correct banner/title/h2 colors. Footer links and email .us correct. Open question: whether the Provider Dashboard Perfil tab's 'Guardar cambios' button actually wires the selected form-owner-identity-* into a backend call. Two transient 401 errors on console during anonymous loads (pre-existing — /api/auth/me, /api/favorites called before session check, same as iter-5/6).
rca_of_the_issue: Likely RCA for owner_identity not persisting via 'Guardar cambios': the global profile save POST/PUT /api/providers/me probably wires only a subset of fields and may not yet include owner_identity in its serialized payload — OR the click handler on form-owner-identity-* updates a local UI state that is overwritten on save submit. Recommended fix: ensure ProviderDashboard's onClick for each form-owner-identity-* button either (a) immediately PUTs to /api/providers/me/owner-identity (write-through), or (b) sets a local state that is included in the profile save payload AND the save button is the one used. A quick verification: tail backend logs while clicking 'Guardar cambios' to see which endpoint is hit.
